# Google Docs Integration

> Auto-generated by Composio Skills Extension on 2026-07-11T01:12:23.801Z
> **Execution**: Via Composio MCP Server (native Claude Code integration)

## Overview

Google Docs is a cloud-based word processor with real-time collaboration, version history, and integration with other Google Workspace apps

This skill uses **Composio MCP** for tool execution. Tools are available as native MCP tools
that Claude can call directly without any Bash commands or scripts.

## MCP Configuration

This integration requires Composio MCP server to be configured in `.mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "composio": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@composio/mcp"],
      "env": {
        "COMPOSIO_API_KEY": "your_api_key",
        "COMPOSIO_ENTITY_ID": "your_entity_id"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Available MCP Tools

### GOOGLEDOCS_COPY_DOCUMENT

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_COPY_DOCUMENT`

Tool to create a copy of an existing Google Document. Use this to duplicate a document, for example, when using an existing document as a template. The copied document will have a default title (e.g., 'Copy of [original title]') if no new title is provided, and will be placed in the user's root Google Drive folder.

**Parameters:**
  - `title` (string, optional): The title for the new copied document. If not provided, the title will be 'Copy of [original document's title]'.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the Google Document to be copied.
  - `include_shared_drives` (boolean, optional): Whether to support copying documents from shared drives. Defaults to True.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_AND_POPULATE_TABLE

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_AND_POPULATE_TABLE`

Creates a new table in a Google Document and populates its cells with provided text data in a single operation. Use this action when you need to insert a structured table with predefined content into a document. The action handles both table creation and cell population automatically, eliminating the need for separate operations.

**Parameters:**
  - `rows` (integer, required): The number of rows in the table. Must be between 1 and 20.
  - `index` (integer, optional): The zero-based index where the table will be inserted, in UTF-16 code units. The index must be strictly less than the segment's end index. To insert at the end of a segment, omit this parameter and set 'insertAtEndOfSegment' to true instead.
  - `tabId` (string, optional): The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.
  - `columns` (integer, required): The number of columns in the table. Must be between 1 and 20.
  - `cellData` (array, required): A 2D array (list of lists) containing the text content for each cell. The outer list represents rows, and each inner list represents columns. Must match the dimensions specified by 'rows' and 'columns'. Empty strings are allowed for empty cells.
  - `segmentId` (string, optional): The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body.
  - `documentId` (string, required): The ID of the document to update.
  - `insertAtEndOfSegment` (boolean, optional): If true, inserts the table at the end of the segment (document body, header, or footer specified by segment_id). If false or omitted, and 'index' is not provided, it defaults to inserting at the end of the document body.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT`

Creates a new Google Docs document using the provided title as filename and inserts the initial text at the beginning if non-empty, returning the document's ID and metadata (excluding body content).

**Parameters:**
  - `text` (string, optional): Optional initial text content to insert at the beginning of the new document. If not provided, an empty document will be created. For very large text (over 50,000 characters), the text will be inserted in chunks to avoid API limits.
  - `title` (string, required): Title for the new document, used as its filename in Google Drive.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT2

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT2`

DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT instead. Tool to create a blank Google Docs document with a specified title. Use when you need to create a new, empty document.

**Parameters:**
  - `title` (string, required): The title of the document to create. This will be used as the document name in Google Drive.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT_MARKDOWN

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT_MARKDOWN`

Creates a new Google Docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as Markdown text.

**Parameters:**
  - `title` (string, required): The title for the new Google Docs document.
  - `image_assets` (array, optional): Optional uploaded images that Markdown can reference by name. Use Markdown image syntax like ![Alt](attachment://diagram). Public HTTPS image URLs in markdown do not need image_assets.
  - `markdown_text` (string, optional): The initial content for the document, formatted as Markdown. Also accepts 'content' as an alias. Supports headings, real Google Docs lists including nested lists, multiple Markdown tables, task-list markers, images via publicly accessible URLs or matching image_assets uploads (max 2KB URL length after resolution; formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF; SVG not supported), blockquotes, code blocks, hyperlinks (e.g., [text](url)), and text formatting (bold, italic, etc.). If empty or omitted, creates document with title only.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_FOOTER

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_FOOTER`

Tool to create a new footer in a Google Document. Use when you need to add a footer, optionally specifying its type and the section it applies to.

**Parameters:**
  - `type` (string, required): The type of footer to create.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document to create the footer in.
  - `section_break_location` (object, optional): The location of the SectionBreak immediately preceding the section whose SectionStyle this footer should belong to. If this is unset or refers to the first section break in the document, the footer applies to the document style.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_FOOTNOTE

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_FOOTNOTE`

Tool to create a new footnote in a Google Document. Use this when you need to add a footnote at a specific location or at the end of the document body.

**Parameters:**
  - `location` (object, optional): Inserts the footnote reference at a specific index in the document. The segmentId within this Location object must be empty as footnotes can only be inserted in the document body.
  - `documentId` (string, required): The ID of the document to create the footnote in.
  - `endOfSegmentLocation` (object, optional): Inserts the footnote reference at the end of the document body. The segmentId within this EndOfSegmentLocation object must be empty.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_HEADER

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_HEADER`

Tool to create a new header in a Google Document, optionally with text content. Use this tool when you need to add a header to a document. You can provide: - document_id: The ID of the document (required) - type: The header type (DEFAULT is the standard header) - text: Optional text content to add to the header - section_break_location: Optional location for section-specific headers

**Parameters:**
  - `text` (string, optional): Optional text content to add to the header after creation. If provided, the text will be inserted into the header at index 0.
  - `type` (string, optional): The type of header to create. Use 'DEFAULT' for the standard document header. Only one DEFAULT header can exist per document; if one already exists, the existing header ID will be returned.
  - `documentId` (string, required): The ID of the document to create the header in.
  - `sectionBreakLocation` (object, optional): The location of the SectionBreak which begins the section this header should belong to. Only needed for section-specific headers.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_NAMED_RANGE

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_NAMED_RANGE`

Tool to create a new named range in a Google Document. Use this to assign a name to a specific part of the document for easier reference or programmatic manipulation.

**Parameters:**
  - `name` (string, required): The name for the new named range. Must be 1-256 characters.
  - `tabId` (string, optional): Optional. The ID of the document tab containing this range. When omitted, Google Docs applies the request to the first tab.
  - `documentId` (string, required): The ID of the document where the named range will be created.
  - `rangeEndIndex` (integer, required): The zero-based end index of the range.
  - `rangeSegmentId` (string, optional): Optional. The ID of the header, footer, or footnote. Empty for document body.
  - `rangeStartIndex` (integer, required): The zero-based start index of the range.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_PARAGRAPH_BULLETS

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_PARAGRAPH_BULLETS`

Tool to add bullets to paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document. Use when you need to format a list or a set of paragraphs as bullet points.

**Parameters:**
  - `tabId` (string, optional): Optional tab ID to apply to createParagraphBullets.range.tabId. When omitted, Google Docs applies the request to the first tab.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document to update.
  - `createParagraphBullets` (object, required): The request body for creating paragraph bullets in the document.

### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_TAB

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_TAB`

Creates a new tab in a Google Docs document. Tabs allow you to organize document content into separate sections within a single document. Use this action when you need to add a new organizational tab to a document. When a tab is added at a specified index, all subsequent tabs' indexes are automatically incremented.

**Parameters:**
  - `document_id` (string, required): The unique identifier of the Google Docs document where the tab will be created. This ID can be found in the document's URL.
  - `tab_properties` (object, optional): Properties of a tab to be created.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_CONTENT_RANGE

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_CONTENT_RANGE`

Tool to delete a range of content from a Google Document. Use when you need to remove a specific portion of text or other structural elements within a document. Note: Every segment (body, header, footer, footnote) in Google Docs ends with a final newline character that cannot be deleted. Ensure the endIndex does not include this trailing newline.

**Parameters:**
  - `range` (object, required): The range of content to delete. Deleting text across paragraph boundaries may merge paragraphs and affect styles. Certain deletions can invalidate document structure (e.g., part of a surrogate pair, last newline of critical elements, incomplete deletion of tables/equations). IMPORTANT: The endIndex must not include the final newline character at the end of a segment (body, header, footer, footnote), as this newline cannot be deleted.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document from which to delete content. This ID can be found in the URL of the Google Doc.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_FOOTER

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_FOOTER`

Tool to delete a footer from a Google Document. Use when you need to remove a footer from a specific section or the default footer.

**Parameters:**
  - `tab_id` (string, optional): The tab that contains the footer to delete. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.
  - `footer_id` (string, required): The ID of the footer to delete. Footer IDs are system-generated strings created by Google Docs. Obtain a valid footer ID from: (1) GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_FOOTER response (footer_id field), or (2) GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID (footers dictionary keys). Do not use made-up or placeholder values. If this footer is defined on DocumentStyle, the reference to this footer is removed, resulting in no footer of that type for the first section of the document. If this footer is defined on a SectionStyle, the reference to this footer is removed and the footer of that type is now continued from the previous section.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document to delete the footer from.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_HEADER

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_HEADER`

Deletes the header from the specified section or the default header if no section is specified. Use this tool to remove a header from a Google Document.

**Parameters:**
  - `tab_id` (string, optional): The tab containing the header to delete. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab.
  - `header_id` (string, required): The ID of the header to delete. If this header is defined on `DocumentStyle`, the reference to this header is removed, resulting in no header of that type for the first section of the document. If this header is defined on a `SectionStyle`, the reference to this header is removed and the header of that type is now continued from the previous section.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document from which to delete the header.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_NAMED_RANGE

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_NAMED_RANGE`

Tool to delete a named range from a Google Document. Use when you need to remove a previously defined named range by its ID or name.

**Parameters:**
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document.
  - `deleteNamedRange` (object, required): Specifies the named range to delete.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_PARAGRAPH_BULLETS

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_PARAGRAPH_BULLETS`

Tool to remove bullets from paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document. Use when you need to clear bullet formatting from a section of a document.

**Parameters:**
  - `range` (object, required): The range of the document from which to delete paragraph bullets. The range is applied to the document body by default. To specify a different segment (e.g. header, footer), include segment_id in the range object.
  - `tab_id` (string, optional): The ID of the tab the range is in. If omitted, it applies to the first tab or the singular tab in a single-tab document.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document to update.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_TAB

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_TAB`

Deletes a tab from a Google Document. This action is irreversible — the tab cannot be recovered once removed. Use when you need to remove a tab and all its child tabs from a document's tab structure.

**Parameters:**
  - `tab_id` (string, required): The ID of the tab to delete. If the tab has child tabs, they will also be deleted.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document containing the tab to delete.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_TABLE_COLUMN

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_TABLE_COLUMN`

Tool to delete a column from a table in a Google Document. Use this tool when you need to remove a specific column from an existing table within a document.

**Parameters:**
  - `requests` (array, required): A list of requests to be applied to the document.
  - `document_id` (string, required): The ID of the document to delete the table column from.

### GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_TABLE_ROW

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_DELETE_TABLE_ROW`

Tool to delete a row from a table in a Google Document. Use when you need to remove a specific row from an existing table.

**Parameters:**
  - `documentId` (string, required): The ID of the document.
  - `tableCellLocation` (object, required): The reference table cell location from which the row will be deleted.

### GOOGLEDOCS_EXPORT_DOCUMENT_AS_PDF

**MCP Tool**: `mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_EXPORT_DOCUMENT_AS_PDF`

Tool to export a Google Docs file as PDF using the Google Drive API. Use when you need to generate a PDF version of a Google Docs document for download or distribution. Note: Google Drive enforces a 10MB limit on export content.

**Parameters:**
  - `file_id` (string, required): The ID of the Google Docs file to export as PDF. This is the same as the document ID for Google Docs files - typically a 44-character alphanumeric string. Extract it from a Google Docs URL: https://docs.google.com/document/d/{FILE_ID}/edit
  - `filename` (string, optional): Optional suggested filename for the exported PDF (e.g., 'report.pdf'). If not provided, a default filename will be generated.

Use MCP tool: mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_COPY_DOCUMENT
Parameters: {
  "document_id": "your_document_id_here"
}
```

Parameters: {
  "documentId": "your_documentId_here",
  "rows": "123"
}
```

#### GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT
```
Use MCP tool: mcp__composio__GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT
Parameters: {
  "title": "your_title_here"
}
```
